codec.integer: zig-zag, 5-bit groups least significant first, one character of the alphabet per group, bit 32 = more groups follow
codec.xy: integers in 10^-q degrees (layer.q): lat, lon pairs; the first vertex of every ring is relative to the first vertex of the previous ring, every other vertex to the previous one; rings are not closed (no repeated first vertex)
codec.len: vertices per ring (line and polygon layers)
codec.r: half-width of the feature in decimetres (one value per feature, absent when all are 0)
codec.f: per-feature flag (bridgeTunnel 1 bridge 2 tunnel; underground/privateLine 1; yongsanPm 1 official zone; noScooterStreet = index in meta.streets)
codec.hole: per ring, 1 when the ring is a hole of the previous ring with 0 (polygon layers; absent when there are no holes)
codec.order: features are sorted by a ~450 m grid cell of their first vertex, then by longitude

units.q: decimal digits of the coordinate integers

rules.name: 서비스 지역 밖
rules.note: Not drawn here: the simulator serves 700 m around a 따릉이 dock.

rules.name: 차도
rules.note: Radius is half the carriageway: OSM width, else lanes x 3 m, else a class default (가정값, 2 m for alleys so their edge stays usable).

rules.name: 자전거도로
rules.note: Half-width 1 m plus 0.5 m = 1.5 m from the centre line (가정값).

rules.name: 지하철 출입구
rules.note: Strictest published value (스윙 약관 10 m); 서울시 and 지쿠 say 5 m. The OSM layer only holds exits missing from OA-21213.

rules.name: 버스정류소
rules.note: 스윙 약관 and 도로교통법 10 m. The OSM layer only holds stops missing from OA-15067.

rules.name: 택시승강장
rules.note: OSM amenity=taxi is sparse.

rules.name: 횡단보도(즉시견인)
rules.note: 3 m before and after the crosswalk; crossing half-width 2 m (가정값) is added. The official OA-22906 points keep their 3 m.

rules.name: 횡단보도(주정차금지)
rules.note: 도로교통법 10 m.

rules.name: 점자블록
rules.note: OSM tactile_paving is sparse. Blocks at crosswalk ends and subway exits lie inside the R07 and R04 radii already.

rules.name: 교통약자 엘리베이터
rules.note: OSM highway=elevator.

rules.name: 교통섬
rules.note: area:highway=traffic_island polygons; most islands are inside a carriageway anyway.

rules.name: 장애인 주차구역
rules.note: OSM parking_space=disabled is very sparse.

rules.name: 소방시설
rules.note: OSM emergency=fire_hydrant is very sparse.

rules.name: 건물 안·지하
rules.note: Building footprints of 12 m2 or more (no roofs or carports) and underground or indoor ways. Doors are outside; use door points.

rules.name: 사유지
rules.note: access=private/no areas (not buildings) and ways; incomplete in OSM.

rules.name: 육교·다리·터널
rules.note: Ways with bridge or tunnel tags; flag 1 bridge, 2 tunnel.

rules.name: 건물 출입구·차량 진입로
rules.note: entrance=* nodes and highway=service+driveway; radius is ours (가정값).

rules.name: 교차로 모퉁이
rules.note: Nodes where streets meet (3 or more ways, or a way running through).

rules.name: 보도 중앙
rules.note: Strip of 1 m around the centre line of footway=sidewalk (width unknown, 가정값).

rules.name: 서울 일반 보도(킥보드)
rules.note: Whole sidewalk, half-width 1.5 m (가정값); PM parking spots are exceptions.

rules.name: 용산구 지정 PM 주차구역 밖
rules.note: Inside the 용산구 polygon only a spot within a yongsanPm zone is legal: the five official zones (data.go.kr 15112113 rows 1-4, the same four in OA-21710, plus 한강진 from the 용산구 notice), lot or exit points geocoded with Kakao Local, 15 m (효창공원앞 20 m, medium confidence) around each.

rules.name: 학교·유치원
rules.note: Inside amenity=school/kindergarten; legal just outside a gate or exit (door points).

rules.name: 병원·관공서
rules.note: amenity=hospital/townhall and office=government; the wiki source is weak.

rules.name: 아파트 단지 안
rules.note: landuse=residential of 3,000-400,000 m2 that holds 2 or more apartment buildings (a share of 6% for those above 150,000 m2) or is tagged apartments or named 아파트; legal just outside a gate or exit.

rules.name: 한강공원
rules.note: leisure=park whose name has 한강공원; kick-scooters only, e-bikes are discouraged there by R27.

rules.name: 도시공원(킥보드)
rules.note: leisure=park of 500 m2 or more (가정값), not 한강공원.

rules.name: 도시공원(전기자전거)
rules.note: Same polygons as R26.

rules.name: 킥보드 없는 거리
rules.note: Parking within 5 m (가정값) is barred and so is riding along the line (범칙금 3만 원); meta.streets has one row per street, the f column is its index.

penalties.basis: policy REPORT 6 (60 s walking equivalent, proposed) and CONTRACT3 (30 m)

streets.note: 마포구 어울마당로 115 앞 1.6 km, 주택가 제외 (서울시 2025). 구간 끝점은 지도 이미지로만 공개됨

streets.name: 대치동 학원가
streets.note: 도곡초 주변 1,630 m (강남구, 한티역까지라는 보도 있음). 도로명은 공개되지 않아 학원가 골목을 OSM에서 추정

streets.name: 위례 트랜짓몰
streets.note: 위례 트랜짓몰 보행로 800 m, 차량 통행 불가 보행 공간 (보도)

streets.name: 연신내 로데오거리
streets.note: 연신내 로데오거리 200 m (보도). 위치는 연신내역 출구 주변으로 추정

notes.subwayExit: 658 dropped because an official point or line is within 6 m
notes.busStop: 3476 dropped because an official point or line is within 8 m
notes.crossingNode: 7486 dropped because an official point or line is within 4 m
notes.yongsan: the five official zones of data.go.kr 15112113 and the 용산구 notice; zone points are parcel or exit points (20-30 m), so each zone is 15 m around its point (효창공원앞 20 m)
notes.osmSparse: crossings, tactile paving, hydrants, disabled parking and taxi stands are sparse in OSM; the official crosswalk layer stays the main R07 source
notes.alleys: residential and unclassified ways with no width or lanes get a 2 m half-width so that an alley edge stays legal
